messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty triggered: PROD - inference-gateway (prod-usw2) - HTTP 5xx error rate > 2% (current 4.8%). Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/prod/5xx
pagerduty: Incident INC-7891 created and auto-assigned to @lucas.oncall
lucas: on it. grabbing graphs
mira: pinging infra if this correlates with deploys
lucas: no deploys in last 30m. spike at 12:03 UTC, concentrated on /v1/generate route
lucas: top upstream: kvcache-proxy eu-west1 showing increased latencies, evictions
shawn: quick check — are we seeing 502 vs 500? logs show 502 (upstream connect reset)
lucas: yep 502 from kvcache proxy pools
mira: rolling back recent proxy config? any canary touching router weights?
shawn: nothing changed in weights. suspect connection churn -> short tcp FINs
lucas: mitigation proposal: 1) shift traffic off problematic pool to dedicated standby pool 2) scale proxy pool + bump keepalive 3) enable fallback routing to dedicated
mira: agree. who can run the routing shift? shawn?
shawn: I can. will start shift to dedicated-pool-3 and scale proxy nodes by +4
shawn: command:
```
./routerctl shift --from=kvcache-proxy-eu-west1 --to=dedicated-pool-3 --percent=30
kubectl scale deploy kvcache-proxy --replicas=12 -n prod
```
lucas: I'll watch for error rate dropping. enabling temporary low-latency circuit-breaker for /v1/generate
mira: setting PD priority to P0 and notifying customer success
customer-success-bot: Notified CS; creating customer-impact notes
shawn: shift started -> 30% at 12:07 UTC
lucas: errors dropping to 3.1% after shift
shawn: ramping to 60%
lucas: error rate 1.4% now :thumbsup:
mira: will keep oncall until stable. planning full swap in 10m then rollback if needed
lucas: leaving brief notes in runbook. will mark incident as mitigated once stable for 15m
incidentbot: Incident INC-7891 acknowledged by lucas
pagerduty: Incident status: acknowledged
mira: hands off to night oncall in 20m (tyler)
tyler: I'll take it — please DM if anything flares. good handoff
lucas: final: root cause suspected upstream kvcache network flaps. follow-up: add connection retries and increase keepalive to reduce handshake churn
mira: filing follow-up ticket #TKT-4122
lucas: closing thread once 15m stable
